description:
## Overview

Get all supported languages for hotel translations and content localization. Use language codes to request hotel data in specific languages.

## When to Use

- **Language selection** - Display available languages to users
- **Content localization** - Get language codes for API requests
- **Multi-language support** - Build language switchers in your application
- **Reference data** - Validate language codes before making requests

## What You Get

- **Language list** - All supported and enabled languages
- **Language codes** - ISO 639-1 codes (e.g., 'en', 'es', 'fr')
- **Language names** - Human-readable language names in English

## Quick Start

No parameters required. Returns all supported languages with codes and names. Use language codes in hotel search and detail requests.
